newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait exchange to list local industrial firm.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait exchange to list local industrial firm.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) has approved the listing of the Aerated Concrete Industries Co (ACIC), bringing the total number of traded concerns to 65, an official said on Tuesday.
Trading in ACIC shares will start on Saturday.
The company, established in 1990, reported a net profit rise to 564,000 dinars ($1.8 million) in 1996 from 410,000 in 1995, figures released by KSE show.
Its assets stood at 7.6 million dinars at the end of 1996 compared with 7.4 million the previous year. It has 34.8 million issued shares with a capital of 3.5 million dinars.

Trade on the KSE is restricted to nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Foreign residents of the Gulf Arab state can invest through listed funds managed by local firms.
